notes.title: Idea FIx Demo 1.0 - moving on to the game proper.
notes.content:
[h1]THE DEMO IS DONE![/h1]

We are also done with the demo. No more secret mechanisms - I swear. 
We're still fixing bugs and stuff - report anything weird / uncouth / sus. 

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

We're shifting our focus to the full game:

[olist]
[*] Finishing the story
[*] Refactoring the code in the backend (to let us do some weird experimental stuff)
[*] Adding more mechanisms to tinker with
[*] Adding more areas to explore and exploit
[/olist]

[h1]"I think you should do X"[/h1]

Email us:
[url=mailto:zuitlabs@gmail.com]zuitlabs@gmail.com[/url]

Join our discord server and talk to the dev team:
[url=https://discord.gg/tgqzUKVeKg]Discord in question[/url]


[h1]Thanks for the amazing support you've shown us![/h1]

If you like what we're doing - [b]wishlist[/b] the game and spread the message!

If you want to see the demo or the main game in a[b] different language[/b] - contact us at [url=mailto:zuitlabs@gmail.com]zuitlabs@gmail.com[/url].

notes.title: "Bucket, list" update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060832/f8ee2c9589ee5f45726f7545df08c17d6f6e48c0.jpg[/img]

[h1]What changed?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a "bucket" / "plate" for the printer. Now you can collect all (most) of the coins at once
[*] Added more console commands, some hidden commands are now displayed in "help"
[*] Changed existing commands so they are easier to type
[*] Mechanism logs are more readable
[*] Secret codes are now emitting particles
[*] "Door opener" is a proper challenge now
[*] You can turn the lamps on/off (try it!)
[*] Fixed some clipping issues, jank colliders
[*] Fixed the wording on most mechanisms
[/list]

[h1]A little bonus:[/h1]

[previewyoutube=PGsnB-xZ12s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Progression streamlined
notes.content:
This update aims to make the game a little bit more user friendly.

Changes:

[list]
[*] Added more hints to the diary for hidden Mechanism codes
[*] Fixed quite a few bugs connected to closing the BP Manager
[*] Added descriptions to achievements
[*] Floppy animation tweaked when inside the Machine
[*] Moved some things around a tiny bit
[/list]

Thanks to all the people submitting bug reports!

notes.title: "Day 1" fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed drag line graphic staying up when dialogues played during interactions
- Fixed game window in the menu taking up too much space on 4K screens and drag line doubling in size. 
Thanks for testing [url=https://youtu.be/YTRH0_dCK5E?si=sIs0Bxoo6DVuGKdS]Wanderbots[/url]!
- Fixed manager mechanism opening while its already open leading to animation "borking up"
- More requested console commands (all the resource names, clear, reset)
- More progression hints
- Probably something else I'm blanking on

Glad that you folks are enjoying our little demo!

If you have any bugs to report or wanna share your opinion use discussions here on Steam or check out our [url=https://discord.gg/e69qMaqug6]Discord[/url].

Or you can try our email zuitlabs@gmail.com
